p: The levirate bond is not substantial. … states … in accordance with the statement of the one who says that the levirate bond is substantial,

The levirate bond is not substantial. This halakha, however, was explained based on the assumption that the levirate bond is substantial. The Gemara answers: Indeed, according to Rav himself it is unnecessary to perform ḥalitza with multiple brothers. He, however, states this halakha in accordance with the statement of the one who says that the levirate bond is substantial,
